_doc: Creature CR -> loot level 1..60, piecewise-linear over cr_points [[CR, level], ...] and clamped at both ends. Boss CRs reach 9,540, so the bands are log-shaped: most of the range is spent where players actually level. area_percentile is the CR percentile of an area's hostile creatures that sets the area's loot level (50 = the median; 75 was tried on 2026-11-06 and reverted: it barely moved towns like Edoras and swallowed areas whose 'elite' troops are a quarter or more of their creatures). boss_overrides pins a specific boss resref to a loot level (Phase 4 reads it). Tune with bin/loot-sim.py.
